contra: Cores: o texto lista 5 cores sem cinza; o seletor da página mostra só Cinza e Preto; as fotos são cinza e preto.
Composição 52% algodão / 48% poliéster, base R$ 59,00 — igual à Rib Wide, Ripple e Waffle; diferente da Piqué (51% poliéster / 49% algodão).
"Tecelagem com canais": é malha (tricô), não tecelagem.
O nome "plissé" sugere plissado termofixado; as fotos mostram um canelado largo e regular. Na prática é a "canelada larga" mais limpa da linha — parece mais Rib Wide que a própria Rib Wide.
Explicação do brilho ("fibras de poliéster orientadas como no cetim") é pseudo-técnica; o brilho provável vem de fio de poliéster filamento ou do acabamento. Pedir ficha do fio.
O resumo fala em "margem de 2–3×" e varejo de R$ 129–179 — alegação sem fonte.

prompt.garment: a regular fit t-shirt in 240gsm plissé-rib textured knit (52% cotton / 48% polyester), {COR}, the entire body and sleeves covered in very regular vertical flat-topped channels about 5–8 mm wide separated by crisp, fine sunken lines, like pressed pleats, running perfectly straight from shoulder to hem and down the sleeves, the channel faces smooth with a soft satin sheen, set-in shoulders, short sleeves ending mid-bicep with a turned double-stitched hem, medium-width smooth matte crew-neck band (no ribbing) in the same color, straight double-stitched hem at the hip, fully opaque
prompt.bottom: light-wash blue jeans with ripped distressing
prompt.colors: CZA (light pearl gray — fotos #1–3), PRT (black — fotos #4–7); OFF, BGE, MRR, MAR só no texto — confirmar
prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: medium-weight 240gsm knit with a crisp, orderly vertical channel structure — the channels are wider and more uniform than a standard rib, and each flat face reflects light like satin while the fine grooves between them stay dark, creating evenly spaced vertical lines of highlight and shadow. The sheen is soft and semi-lustrous, never metallic or plastic: seen straight on, the shirt looks deep and structured, and where the torso turns away from the light the channels catch a gradient of satin highlights. On light gray the grooves read as fine graphite lines; on black the channels glow with dark satin reflections. The matte collar band contrasts with the sheen of the body; reinforced seams, turned double-stitched hems, anti-torsion finish keeping the channels perfectly vertical. Movement: the structure makes the fabric fold along the channels — soft vertical pleats form at the sides of the waist and under the arm, and the highlights slide across the channels as the body turns.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): body length 72 cm ending at the hip, chest width 54 cm giving 2–4 cm of relaxed ease, shoulder width 46 cm with the shoulder seam sitting exactly on the shoulder point, sleeve length 18 cm ending mid-bicep. Little stretch: the silhouette stays regular and the vertical channels visually lengthen the torso.
